# REL-54: Simulator: seed processor draws on the payment reference (ADR-0012)

Status: **Done** | Phase 1 - Showcase slice | Owner: Claude | issue #291

## Outcome

Simulator: seed processor draws on the payment reference (ADR-0012)

## Depends on

- [REL-13](REL-13.md) CI pipeline and local verification gate - Done
- [REL-19](REL-19.md) Simulated Processors A and B with latency, decline-rate and outage controls - Done

## Unblocks

- [REL-21](REL-21.md) Async payment worker: routes, authorizes and captures via the processors

## Acceptance

- [x] The processor API accepts an optional `reference` in the authorize and capture body (1 to 64 characters: letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`); an invalid value returns 422 `validation_error`
- [x] Every draw hashes the seed, processor, the reference when present (otherwise the payment id), attempt number and operation; the idempotency key stays `<payment_id>:<attempt_no>`
- [x] Two payments with different ids and the same reference draw the same outcome; without a reference the behaviour and every existing test are unchanged
- [x] The reference is part of the body, so a repeated key with a different reference is 409 `idempotency_key_reused`
- [x] api-contract.md "Simulator APIs" matches the implementation

## Steps

1. **REL-54.1 Write failing tests for reference-seeded draws** (done) - In `simulator/tests/`, add tests that two payment ids with one reference get identical outcomes and latencies on both processors and operations, that no reference keeps today's payment-id draws, that an invalid reference is 422 and that a repeated key with a different reference is 409.
2. **REL-54.2 Accept the optional reference in the processor API** (done) - Add `reference` (optional, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$`) to the authorize and capture body in `simulator/app/apps.py` and to `ChargeRequest`, so it takes part in the stored-request comparison.
3. **REL-54.3 Seed draws on the reference** (done) - In `simulator/processors/outcomes.py` and `simulator.py`, pass the reference (or the payment id when absent) as the draw key; keep the idempotency key and stored results unchanged. Run `sim-tests` and `sim-lint`.
4. **REL-54.4 Open pull request and pass review** (done) - Open a pull request that links ADR-0012, run the checks, get an independent review and merge only after `gh pr checks` passes.
